test_navigate_to_admin_users.title: Verify navigating to Admin > Users section loads the user list

steps.action: Open Admin and click Users in the sidebar.
steps.expected: The Users list opens with its search field.

test_add_user.title: Verify a new user can be added via the Add User form.

steps.action: Open the application login page
steps.expected: Login page loads with username and password fields

steps.action: Log in with the required user role/credentials
steps.expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the default page

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Permissions - Maps
steps.expected: Permissions - Maps page loads (or access denied, depending on the test)

steps.action: Verify the access behavior matches the expected permission level
steps.expected: User can access or is correctly blocked from the feature

steps.action: Verifying Admin user permissions for Map configuration actions - Add New Map dialog opens displaying Map Name field
steps.expected: Verifying admin user permissions is displayed as expected (for Map configuration actions - Add New Map dialog opens displaying Map Name field)

steps.action: Verify no unauthorized data or controls are exposed
steps.expected: Only permitted content is visible to the current user role

steps.action: Set up precondition: for Map configuration actions - Add New Map dialog opens displaying Map Name field
steps.expected: Precondition is met (for Map configuration actions - Add New Map dialog opens displaying Map Name field)

steps.action: Log out and verify the session ends cleanly
steps.expected: User is redirected to the login page after logout

test_search_user.title: Verify the search input filters users by name.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search - Insights
steps.expected: Search - Insights page loads without errors

steps.action: Verify the initial unfiltered list or data set is displayed
steps.expected: All items are shown before applying any search or filter

steps.action: Note the total count of items before filtering
steps.expected: Initial item count is recorded

steps.action: Locate the search input field or filter controls
steps.expected: Search/filter UI is visible and accessible

steps.action: Enter the search criteria or select the filter option for Search field displays placeholder text before user input
steps.expected: Search/filter input accepts the value

steps.action: Trigger the search or apply the filter (press Enter or click Apply)
steps.expected: The list updates to show filtered results

steps.action: Verify the results match the search/filter criteria
steps.expected: All displayed items match the applied criteria

steps.action: Verify the result count updated to reflect the filtered set
steps.expected: Item count is less than or equal to the original count

steps.action: Clear the search/filter and verify all items return
steps.expected: Clearing the filter restores the full unfiltered list

test_toggle_user_status.title: Verify a user's active and suspended toggle flips and flips back

steps.action: Open Admin > Users and search for AutoTest.
steps.expected: An automation user is listed. With none the test skips naming the tenant's data.

steps.action: Click that user's status toggle.
steps.expected: The toggle flips to the other state.

steps.action: Click it again.
steps.expected: The toggle returns to the state it started in, so the shared tenant is left as it was.

test_role_filter_options.title: Verify the role filter dropdown contains expected roles

steps.action: Open Admin > Users and open the role filter dropdown.
steps.expected: The dropdown offers Admin, Operator and Supervisor.

test_select_role_filter.title: Verify the Users list can be filtered by role

steps.action: Open Admin > Users and click the role filter.
steps.expected: The role list opens.

steps.action: Choose Admin.
steps.expected: The filter shows Admin as its value.

test_delete_user.title: Verify a user can be deleted via options menu > delete > confirm

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click Users.
steps.expected: The Users list opens.

steps.action: Type AutoTest in the user search field.
steps.expected: The list shrinks to the AutoTest users.

steps.action: Click the options icon on an AutoTest user card, then click Delete.
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog opens.

steps.action: Click Delete in the dialog.
steps.expected: The user card is removed, the list shows one card fewer, and no error is shown.
